map.以「里程表 15 万 km、车龄 5 年、年基准 2 万 km、超额费率 1 元: Example: 'odometer 150k km, age 5 yr, baseline 20k km/yr, excess rate 1 CNY/km, original 100k, tolerance 30%'

Excess fee=50k×1=50000 CNY; value adj=-min(25%, 50%×0.30=-15%)=-15%, i.e., original 100k minus 15k → adjusted 85k. Lease also pays 50k excess fee.
map.超里程时每超 10% 扣约 3% 价值（偏差率×0.30），封顶 -25%；少里: Over-mileage: each +10% bias cuts ~3% value (bias×0.30), capped at -25%; under-mileage: each -10% adds ~0.5% (|bias|×0.05), capped at +5%. This penalizes severe over-mileage yet rewards low-mileage cars.
map.tol 是允许的正常偏差比例（如 30%），偏差在此区间内判「正常磨损」不调整价: Tol is the allowed normal-bias ratio (e.g., 30%); within it wear is 'normal' and value is unchanged; beyond it charges or adjusts. Once the lease contract sets tolerance, this param maps directly to the contract threshold.
